messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Adderall may also be used for purposes not listed in this medication guide.

Extended-release formulations of Adderall (Adderall XR) are only used to treat ADHD.
Triplet: ["Adderall", "has legal warning", "selling or giving away is against the law"]

The relation 'has legal warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with a legal warning or restriction specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
D. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'has controlled substance schedule': The subject drug is classified under the controlled substance schedule specified by the object entity.
